top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
top_stories.summary: Microsoft suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service. The attack resulted in unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is notifying organizations via Azure Service Health about an exploited vulnerability in the Microsoft Entra Connect Health API that allowed unauthorized parties to gain read-only access to tenant-level metadata. The flaw affected the API layer of Entra Connect Health, a service used to monitor on-premises identity infrastructure such as Active Directory Federation Services and AD DS.

top_stories.title: Azure API Management vulnerability exploited to steal customers’ secrets
top_stories.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) to steal credentials stored in customer instances, with confirmed victims including Norwegian energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi. APIM Classic tiers were affected, as APIM handles authentication, routing, and rate limiting for organizations' APIs.

top_stories.title: Daten abgeflossen: Microsoft gesteht Datenpanne bei Entra Connect Health
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed a data breach involving a security vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health, through which attackers exfiltrated data from on-premises systems. Affected customers are being notified of the incident.

top_stories.title: Attackers exploited Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw to access tenant data
top_stories.summary: Attackers exploited a vulnerability in the Microsoft Entra Connect Health API to access tenant data, including technical contact email addresses and configuration details. Microsoft has warned affected organizations about the breach involving this cloud-based monitoring service for hybrid identity infrastructure.

news.title: ShinyHunters-linked crew resurfaces on new leak site
news.summary: Okta's threat intelligence team discovered that a crew linked to ShinyHunters has resurfaced under the name "Inception" after the original leak site went dark in September. Okta tracks the group as O-UNC-053, identifying it as running social engineering and credential-harvesting campaigns since March 2026 across multiple sectors including technology, healthcare, and financial services.

news.title: GlobeTopper faces up to $2.5 million in lost revenue after hackers steal $70,000 in gift cards
news.summary: Hackers breached GlobeTopper, a B2B digital gift card platform, stealing API credentials belonging to business customers and redeeming approximately $70,000 in gift cards without authorization. The breach, detected on October 22, resulted in the platform being taken offline, with parent company iQSTEL reporting potential revenue losses of up to $2.5 million in an SEC filing.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
news.summary: Norway's National Security Authority disclosed a security vulnerability in Microsoft's Azure API Management (APIM) that has been actively exploited by an unknown threat actor targeting access tokens, secrets, and named values. Multiple Norwegian businesses were affected, including energy companies, with Microsoft subsequently issuing a fix for the classic flaw.

news.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
news.summary: CrowdStrike is reportedly pursuing a $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler, combining endpoint protection with zero-trust network security. The deal would unite CrowdStrike's endpoint capabilities with Zscaler's zero-trust architecture, with a focus on securing AI agents.

news.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
news.summary: Microsoft warned customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was actively exploited to steal stored API credentials. Norwegian authorities linked the flaw to cyberattacks targeting energy companies.

news.title: AI Agents Are Creating a Shared Responsibility Gap
news.summary: Token Security has published research examining how AI agents operating across multiple platforms create security gaps in identity and access management, where no single vendor maintains full visibility or control. The analysis focuses on managing agent identities, permissions, and accountability as AI agents introduce new challenges to traditional authorization and access control models.

news.title: Okta appoints Rohan Vaidya as Vice-President and General Manager, India
news.summary: Okta has appointed Rohan Vaidya as Vice-President and General Manager for India. Vaidya will be responsible for leading growth, partnerships, and enterprise identity security initiatives in the Indian market.

news.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health Leaked Tenant Metadata for Four Months. No Patch to Install, but Your Admin Emails Are Now Phishing Targets.
news.summary: Microsoft Entra Connect Health exposed tenant metadata for approximately four months, affecting organizations using the identity synchronization monitoring service. The leaked data included admin email addresses, which Microsoft has flagged as a phishing risk, with no patch required but a security advisory issued through the Azure portal.

news.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
news.summary: Security vendors are developing converging approaches across identity, runtime, and development controls to address access-control challenges for AI agents in enterprise environments. Vendors' approaches vary significantly, leaving CISOs to evaluate competing solutions for keeping AI agents within defined authorization boundaries.

news.title: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
news.summary: Rackspace disclosed a breach of its Spot cloud platform in which attackers used compromised credentials to gain unauthorized access to customer Kubernetes clusters. The attackers were able to deploy unauthorized workloads and access Kubernetes secrets, highlighting credential-based access risks in cloud environments.

news.title: Entra Connect Health data exposure: what to do | Enzo Soler
news.summary: Microsoft disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in the Entra Connect Health API to access tenant metadata, including administrator email addresses, tenant IDs, and license tiers. Microsoft patched the flaw server-side on November 19, with no customer-side action required.

news.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit Critical VMware vCenter Zero-Day to Gain Admin Access and Steal Data
news.summary: A China-linked threat group known as Armory Castle exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890, CVSS 9.8) in VMware vCenter Server to gain unauthorized admin access and steal data. The flaw is an authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service, allowing attackers to circumvent access controls without valid credentials.

news.title: Scope down permissions of existing sessions using AWS STS GetScopedCredentials
news.summary: AWS has introduced a new Security Token Service (STS) API called GetScopedCredentials that allows developers to narrow the permissions of existing sessions rather than granting full session permissions. The API is designed for AI agent workflows where each agent or sub-agent should operate with least-privilege access scoped to its specific tasks.

news.title: Stock Looks Fully Valued On New Onboarding Security Tie Up
news.summary: SailPoint is highlighted in a financial analysis examining whether its 25.2% annual stock return is justified by its cash flows. The article focuses on a new onboarding security partnership and upcoming investor events related to the IAM vendor.

news.title: jumpserver v5.2.0
news.summary: JumpServer has released version 5.2.0 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides DevOps and IT teams with secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database, and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.

news.title: Windows 11 passkey bug cries failure after successful sign-in
news.summary: Microsoft released an optional update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2 to fix a passkey authentication bug that displayed a misleading failure error after a successful Android sign-in. The bug caused the sign-in process to report failure despite completing successfully, creating confusion for users authenticating with passkeys on Android devices.

news.title: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes
news.summary: Microsoft released the KB5132057 preview update for Windows 11, which includes 28 changes and fixes. Among the updates are improvements to Windows Hello, the biometric authentication feature built into Windows 11.

news.title: authentik version/2026.8.6
news.summary: authentik released version 2026.8.6 of its open-source identity provider platform. The release supports SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, and RADIUS protocols for centralized authentication, authorization, and access management.

news.title: Your AWS Security, Identity, and Governance guide to re:Invent 2026
news.summary: AWS is promoting its Security, Identity, and Governance track at re:Invent 2026, scheduled for November 30 to December 4 in Las Vegas. The announcement highlights identity challenges related to AI agents operating autonomously across systems as a key theme for the event.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports aliases to simplify workload configuration
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has added support for aliases, allowing administrators to assign human-readable names to trust anchors, profiles, and certificate revocation lists. Workloads can now request temporary credentials using these aliases instead of ARNs, simplifying configuration and management.

news.title: Major Brazilian Signature Apps Enable RCE & Fraud
news.summary: Brazilian government-sanctioned authentication middleware applications used for legally binding document signing contain remote code execution vulnerabilities. The flaws affect signature apps that handle exceptionally important legal documents, exposing them to both RCE attacks and fraud.
